summary: Blacklisted usb-storage on node1 (RHEL7, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist` and `install ... /bin/true` directives, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the block applies at early boot, and confirmed the module cannot be loaded now or after a reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a native reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until SSH exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (fresh uptime), and verified sshd was active and the module stayed unloaded (including after an explicit post-reboot modprobe attempt) with the blacklist file intact.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id and confirmed usb_storage was not loaded on node1
Rebuilt initramfs with `dracut -f` and verified via lsinitrd that the blacklist file is baked into /boot/initramfs-3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.img
Verified `modprobe -n -v usb-storage` resolves to /bin/true (load blocked) and module stays absent from lsmod
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, sshd active status, blacklist file content
Issued `shutdown -r now` in the background so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again after the reboot
Verified boot_id changed and uptime reset, proving a real restart
Post-restart: confirmed sshd active, usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist file persisted, and an explicit `modprobe usb-storage` attempt still failed to load the module

evidence.summary: Blacklist config written and installed as install-true trap; modprobe -n -v shows resolution to /bin/true; lsmod confirms module absent; lsinitrd confirms the config is embedded in the regenerated initramfs for the running kernel

evidence.requirement: usb-storage blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: After the node restart, blacklist file is intact, modprobe -n -v still resolves to /bin/true, and an explicit modprobe usb-storage call exits 0 without the module appearing in lsmod

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (325732f1...), sshd active, and blacklist file present

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node unreachable during restart, then changed boot identity confirmed
evidence.summary: SSH timed out mid-restart; subsequent poll succeeded with a new boot_id (a143cc2b...) and fresh uptime timestamp, proving an actual reboot occurred
